data_requests.note: Future runs only. These requests never break the current evidence freeze and do not launch collectors.

requests.decision_impact: Prevents position-level P&L and conviction decisions from being based on the wrong contract or component of a derived expression.

alerts: Canada official curve is unavailable, so the position stays locked to the tradable CORRA/CRA futures family.
Full 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip cheapens materially from the low-3.4s with follow-through
March 2027 CORRA above ~3.20 while Brent remains elevated
Canadian core inflation or labor reaccelerates
BoC communication validates a materially tighter 2027 policy path
pms.invalidation: De-risk if the full 2027 strip cheapens materially beyond its current low-3.4s area with follow-through, especially if March also pushes through roughly 3.20 and persistent Brent strength is confirmed by firmer Canadian core inflation, labor, or explicitly hawkish BoC guidance. A one-day energy move alone is not enough.
pms.label: ChatGPT
pms.mandate: Final synthesis; may trade or choose no-trade. No forced style.

positions.invalidation: Reduce or close if Canadian core inflation moves decisively above the current near-2% zone while employment and wage growth reaccelerate, or if BoC communication/delivered hikes validate a 2027 path in the mid-3% area. A headline-energy spike without confirmation in core inflation and labor is not sufficient invalidation.
positions.thesis: Receive the 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip. The market prices roughly 84 to 130.5 bp of BoC tightening from a 2.29% overnight rate even though Canadian labor is weak and core inflation is near 2%; the 2027 hike cycle is too aggressive relative to the domestic reaction function.

pms.thesis: Keep the existing 2027 H/M/U/Z CORRA receive, but do not add. March 2027 at 3.145 still embeds roughly 85bp of tightening versus about 2.30 cash, while the full strip is materially higher because the later-2027 contracts carry more tightening and inflation premium. Canadian domestic evidence still does not clearly validate that whole path, but Brent at 104.32 makes the later strip substantially less clean than the March-only receive.

pms.label: Swinger
pms.mandate: Very aggressive/concentrated when the thesis is valid. HEDGE prohibited; reduce or close instead.

positions.invalidation: Close if CRAH27 implied rises toward CRAM27 3.365 rather than cheapening. A US-only SOFR selloff that leaves CORRA_2027-03 unchanged is not invalidation. Energy headlines without a core/labor break are not invalidation. No hedge: if the thesis fails, close.
positions.thesis: Duration-long / receive MX CRAH27 (paper alias CORRA_2027-03, family locked to CORRA/CRA). Long in this book is long duration with P&L inverted in implied-rate space: profits if Mar-27 implied CORRA falls from 3.13 toward the still-alive near-term path (1m Dec-2026 2.58, 3m Dec-2026 CRAZ26 2.775), not if Canada catches up to SOFR. The 2027 contract is where the unwarranted hiking cycle is concentrated; do not migrate onto SOFR, AONIA, CA-US 2Y, or USDCAD.

pms.thesis: March 2027 CORRA at 3.125 still prices 82 basis points of tightening from cash 2.30, so a receive that profits as implied marks fall is not dead. Oil at 105 with deal pessimism is an inflation and Canadian terms-of-trade shock that makes 1.7 billion the wrong size on that line, and a second market will not be overlaid to offset it. Cut the live receive hard and keep a smaller concentrated long only because the already-priced hike path still looks rich versus cash.

positions.invalidation: Thesis fails if BoC hikes or the 1m CORRA strip through Dec-2026 reprices toward the 2027 CRA mid-3s; if CPI-trim/median leave the 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment stops contracting and wages re-accelerate; or if CORRA_2027-03 implied holds at or above the 3.13 entry because catch-up is actually being delivered. A US-only or energy-headline move that leaves CRAH27 unchanged is not…
positions.thesis: That is the first 2027 three-month contract that prices a Canadian hiking cycle (+84bp vs CORRA cash 2.29) after 1m CORRA still only reaches 2.58 by Dec-2026 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is 2.775. August labor (-42k, wages +2.0%) and CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0 do not support delivering that 2027 path. Side long is duration-long in implied-rate space (profits if the 3.13 implied falls toward the still-alive near-term path).

pms.thesis: Receive Mar27 CORRA remains the book: cash at 2.30 versus a 3.125 forward still pays you to fade a fully advertised tightening path, even with Brent at 105. Deal pessimism and oil are the adverse, but they are already why that forward sits 82bp above cash, not a fresh reason to flip the seat. A 25mm pay in the same contract would offset only a sliver of the 450mm receive, and a 25mm pay in SOFR Mar27 at 4.705 is a US hike-trend sidecar that does not hedge Canada’s oil-exporter inflation channel.

pms.invalidation: Stay-flat is wrong if Mar-27 implied rates cheapen enough versus cash that a modest further hawk still covers 3.90 percent SOFR on 100-basis-point shocked capital, or if official cash SOFR falls while those forwards stay elevated enough to create positive carry after the same shock.
pms.label: Grinder
pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
pms.thesis: Official cash SOFR at 3.90 percent is the hurdle on any new shocked-risk pay, and neither Mar-27 implied rate leaves enough residual edge after the hike path already on the screen. Canadian Mar-27 at 3.125 versus 2.30 cash already prices 82.5 basis points of tightening; oil near 105 supports a hawk story but does not cover a fresh 25 million pay once a 100-basis-point adverse move is the shock. US Mar-27 at 4.705 versus 3.90 cash already prices 80.5 basis points, so another pay is SOFR-funded risk into an extended path. The book stays flat.
